thread:
Alex: Heads-up — I'm starting onboarding for mosaic-7b-v2 into the catalog. Need to confirm artifact locations and run perf profiles. I found weights at s3://redwood-models/mosaic/mosaic-7b-v2/sha256-abcdef123456. Can infra confirm this is the canonical path? Also seeing a tokenizer quirk: EOS vs eos_token mismatch causing trailing garbage in chat flows. Should we patch tokenizer.json or do post-processing?

Rachel: I opened a small PR to override tokenizer fields: https://git.redwood/infra/PR/987. We set pad_token to <|pad|> and added a canonicalization step. PR updates model card too.

Dmitri: Confirmed weights path and checksum on our side (matches). Quantized artifacts are present under s3://redwood-models/mosaic/mosaic-7b-v2/q4_0/. For perf, we should test both fp16 and q4_0.

Kevin: I can run perf tomorrow. What batch sizes and seq lengths do we want? Also want to validate onboarding config: kv-cache enabled, tensor-parallel settings, max position embeddings?

Alex: Target seq lengths: 256 and 1024. Batch sizes: 1,4,8,16. Target p99 latency <120ms at batch=1 for fp16 on A100-80. Use kv-cache=true, max_seq=2048. Runtime flags: --prefix-cache --control-batching=auto.

Rachel: Quick note on tokenizer: some tokens map to <|endoftext|> incorrectly when bos_token_id != eos_token_id. The PR includes tokenizer_patch and we also canonicalize in load_model. Snippet:
```python
# loader patch
tok = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained(path)
if tok.bos_token_id != tok.eos_token_id:
    tok.bos_token = tok.eos_token
    tok.bos_token_id = tok.eos_token_id
```

Dmitri: For perf runs use bench-runner v0.9.2. Example command: `bench-runner --model s3://redwood-models/mosaic/mosaic-7b-v2/ --mode perf --batch-sizes 1,4,8,16 --seq-lens 256,1024 --dtypes fp16,q4_0 --repeat 3 --output /tmp/mosaic7b-perf.json`

perf-bot: Scheduled perf job #perf-171000 into queue on dedicated pool a100-us-west2. Notified @Kevin. :white_check_mark:

Kevin: Ack. Starting fp16 passes now. Will ping when first numbers are in.

Alex: Also add config validation to onboarding CI: check tokenizer.pad_token exists, vocab_size matches model config, decoder start token present, kv-cache flag true. I'll open a small spec PR for that.

Rachel: If perf shows p99 >120ms, fallback plan: recommend q4_0 in model card and document tuning (smaller batch sizes, prefix-cache warming).

Kevin: First run (fp16, batch=1, seq=256): mean ~95ms, p95 ~110ms, p99 ~140ms — p99 slightly over target. Re-running with --prefix-cache warmup=20.

perf-bot: Job perf-171000 finished. Summary uploaded to /artifacts/perf/perf-171000.json. Highlights: fp16 b1 s256 p50 90ms p95 108ms p99 138ms; q4_0 b1 s256 p50 70ms p95 85ms p99 115ms.

Alex: Great. @Rachel can you add q4_0 as a recommended fallback in the model card and tag the catalog entry with perf:baseline-2024-03? :eyes:

Dmitri: I'll land the checksum & artifacts in the model registry and update the catalog config. Also scheduling a full sweep (all batches + seq1024) overnight.

Kevin: Notes for follow-up: validate streaming decode correctness after tokenizer patch — saw one example of repeated newline tokens.

Rachel: Added a small playback test to onboarding CI: given prompt, expect stop token within first 200 tokens; will link test in PR.

Alex: Thanks all — I'll follow up with PR numbers and close the thread once the catalog entry is live. :white_check_mark:
